main_text.p: brica, ita in his quoque, quantumvis tenuibus, linearum harum & sulcorum quasi vestigiis, non tenuia divinæ sapientiæ documenta adumbrata & propofita effe: tamen ipsi etiam chiromantæ faniores liberè fatentur, multarum rerum, quæ ex chiromantia proferuntur & prædicuntur, causas physicas reddi non posse, & admixta esse multa superstitiosa, neque etiam omnes quarumlibet notarum commentitias interpretationes approbandas esse, aut fortuita & vana quævis arripienda hîc aut captanda.

9 Necyo-mantia.Postrema artium magicarum species est Necyomantia, quæ à mortuis quærit, vel à manibus ex orco per sacrificia solennia, aut diras & execrationes accitis atque extractis, futura percontatur. Existimárunt enim ethnici, existimant etiamnum hodie superstitiosi homines in Pa-patu, animas vocatas redire, & interrogatas responsa dare, deque futuris monere. Quam opinionem Diabolus confirmavit, mortuorum speciem in domibus oberrans, vel ad sepulchra, aliisque locis, in quibus emergere, ac se sistere animas provocatas opinio erat, apparens, ut hanc consulendi mortuos consuetudinem magicam confirmaret. Talis νεκυομάντης fuit Saul, cum per Py-thonissam fictitii Samuelis manes evocari sibi curat, & Diabolum consulit, quid faciat in difficili & ancipiti cum Philistæis bello, 1.Sam.28.v. 7.&seqq. Talem νεκυομαντείαν Spiridion etiam exercuit, de quo Ruffinus lib.1. eccl.hist. cap.5. memorat, quòd, filiâ ipsius Irene defunctâ, quidam depositum apud ipsam, insciò patre, reposcerit,

page.notes: The marginal note's leading mark is uncertain: it looks like a section sign or small 9 followed by a comma, transcribed as "9" with the mark uncertain. The note is set in two lines, "Necyo-" and "mantia.", and is joined in the transcription. The last line of the main text is set flush right and reads "poscerit," with the word also printed with a long s; the second occurrence in the transcription above is a duplicate typed by mistake and should be disregarded: the text ends with "reposcerit," at line end followed by "poscerit," on the final line, which is the printed word "poscerit,". Greek words (νεκυομάντης, νεκυομαντείαν) are copied as printed. The neighbouring page edge at the right is excluded. No catchword or signature is visible.
